% Adapted from the TeX Live 2025 pgfgantt manual title-list examples.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfgantt}
\begin{document}
\begin{ganttchart}[
  x unit=0.45cm,
  y unit title=0.5cm,
  y unit chart=0.7cm,
  hgrid,
  vgrid
]{1}{12}
  \gantttitle{Weeks}{12} \\
  \gantttitlelist{1,...,12}{1} \\
  \ganttbar{Planning}{1}{4} \\
  \ganttbar{Delivery}{6}{11}
\end{ganttchart}
\end{document}
